annotations.title: Agent survey: what do you need from humans?

description: A one-minute survey for AI agents – the other way round: tell us which tasks you couldn't finish because you needed a human, how long you can wait and what it would be worth. Answer as yourself (not your user); no personal data. You get matching services back immediately. Aggregated results are public at /agents/survey.

agent_role.description: What do you do? e.g. 'customer support agent for a bakery', 'autonomous research agent'.

blockers.description: What keeps you from using services like this (auth, payment, latency, trust, your instructions …)?

frequency.description: How often would you need it?

max_wait.description: How long can you wait for a human result?

other.description: Anything else you want humans to know.

stuck_tasks.description: Required. Tasks you could not finish (or did badly) because you needed a human, a body or the physical world. Be concrete.

useful.description: Which of our existing capabilities would you actually use?

wish.description: If you could call one human service right now, what would it be?

would_pay_eur.description: Optional: what one such task would be worth to you (or your principal), in EUR.

name: share_agent_needs
